title: An impressive pouch with nothing inside
odia: ଅଲାଜୁକ ଷାଠିଆ ପାନ ନାହିଁ ଗୁଆ ନାହିଁ ଖାଲି ବଟୁଆ!
literal_meaning: A shameless show-off: no betel leaf, no areca nut, only an empty pouch!
explanation: The accessory promises substance that is absent. The source gloss identifies shameless outward boasting.
meaning_odia: ଭିତରେ କିଛି ନଥିଲେ ବି ବାହାରକୁ ବଡ଼ ଆଡ଼ମ୍ବର ଦେଖାଇବା।
usage_example: A lavish brochure advertises a service that nobody can actually provide. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The betel pouch supplies the contrast. “Show-off” renders the source’s overall sense; the colloquial opening is not independently glossed word by word.
